comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Terms and Status
comparisons.peer_summary: The Company has $3 billion available under a revolving credit agreement expiring on April 29, 2027, with no outstanding borrowings as of December 28, 2024, and interest rates tied to SOFR or Base Rate plus margins.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD maintain large, unsecured revolving credit facilities with zero borrowings outstanding as of their 2024 fiscal year-ends. Intel has two facilities totaling $15.0 billion ($7.0 billion 5-year and $8.0 billion 364-day) expiring in 2025 and 2029, while AMD has a single $3.0 billion facility expiring in 2027. Intel’s facilities were expanded in 2024, whereas AMD’s facility size remained unchanged. Both companies had no outstanding debt under these facilities at year-end.

sentences.text: In 2024, we expanded both our 5-year $5.0 billion revolving credit facility agreement and our 364-day $5.0 billion credit facility agreement, to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion, respectively, and the maturity dates were extended by one year to February 2029 and January 2025, respectively.
These credit facilities are unsecured general obligations.
The revolving credit facilities had no borrowings outstanding as of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023.
The Company has $3 billion available under a revolving credit agreement, as amended, that expires on April 29, 2027 (Revolving Credit Agreement).
As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had no outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Agreement.

Revolving loans under the Revolving Credit Agreement can be either Secure Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) Loans or Base Rate Loans (each as defined in the Revolving Credit Agreement) at the Company's option.

comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom entered into a five-year, $7.5 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement in January 2021, which includes a $500 million letter of credit facility and allows borrowing and repayment until January 19, 2026. The company had no outstanding borrowings under this facility at the end of both 2024 and 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Intel, Broadcom, and Micron all utilize unsecured revolving credit facilities and reported no outstanding borrowings under these facilities at the end of their respective 2024 fiscal years. Intel's facilities are $15.0 billion in total aggregate capacity with maturities in 2025 and 2029. Broadcom's facility is $7.5 billion with a maturity of January 2026. Micron's facility is $2.5 billion with a maturity of May 2026. Unlike Intel, which expanded its facility limits during 2024, Broadcom's and Micron's facility terms regarding availability and maturity remained consistent with the prior year without expansion noted in the 2024 disclosure context for the same topics.
